title: Norwegian Tacos
description: A fusion of Norwegian and Mexican cuisine, these tacos are a unique twist on traditional tacos. With the addition of pork and Norwegian flavors, this dish is sure to be a hit.

ingredients.name: Lap desk Norwegian flatbread (or substitute with corn tortillas)

instructions: In a large skillet, cook the pork over medium-high heat until browned.
Add the taco seasoning and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the cabbage to the skillet and cook until wilted.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing the pork mixture onto the tortillas and topping with fixings.
